name: Admidio
description: Admidio is an open-source user management system for websites of organizations and groups. It has a flexible role model that allows you to reflect the structure and permissions of your organization.

name: Agregore
description: Agregore is a peer-to-peer web browser supporting multiple DWeb protocols (IPFS, Hypercore, BitTorrent, Gemini), enabling browsing and hosting of decentralised web content.

name: Akaunting
description: Akaunting is an open-source accounting and invoicing software designed for small businesses and freelancers. It offers features for invoicing, expense tracking, and financial reporting.

name: Althea
description: Althea is a blockchain-based system enabling mesh network participants to pay each other for bandwidth using cryptocurrency, creating automated billing for community network infrastructure.

name: Ansible
description: Ansible is an open-source automation tool for configuration management, application deployment, and task automation. It is widely used by ISPs and community networks for managing network devices and infrastructure.

name: AnythingLLM
description: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one desktop and Docker AI application with built-in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, a no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It is designed for easy deployment and management of LLM applications.

name: Art of WiFi
description: Art of WiFi provides a UniFi API client for WiFi management.

name: Audiopedia
description: Audiopedia provides audio content for women in developing countries, funded by the Smart Development Fund (BMZ/GIZ). Accessible via mobile without literacy requirements.
notes: Supported by Smart Development Fund created by BMZ/GIZ.

name: Authelia
description: Authelia is an open-source Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) portal for web applications. It provides secure access to multiple services with a single set of credentials.

name: Authentik
description: Authentik is a flexible identity provider that supports multiple protocols, including OAuth 2.0, SAML, LDAP, and Radius. It is designed to be easy to deploy and manage.
notes: Recommended as a Keycloak alternative in community network circles.

name: Auvik
description: Auvik is a cloud-based network management and monitoring platform that provides real-time monitoring, automated network discovery, and troubleshooting tools. It is designed for managed service providers (MSPs) and ISPs.

name: AzuraCast
description: AzuraCast is a self-hosted web radio management suite including Icecast and SHOUTcast support, scheduling, and listener statistics. Used for community and online radio stations.

name: B.A.T.M.A.N.
description: B.A.T.M.A.N. (Better Approach To Mobile Ad-hoc Networking) is a routing protocol for multi-hop ad-hoc mesh networks, widely used as the backbone for community mesh deployments.

name: BIND
description: BIND (Berkeley Internet Name Domain) is the most widely used open-source DNS software on the Internet. It provides a robust and flexible platform for DNS management.

name: Becknprotocol
description: Beckn is an open digital infrastructure protocol for decentralised commerce interactions, removing the need for a central platform or authority to enable transactions between participants.
notes: Developed with links to Aadhaar architects; some controversy about openness.

name: Berty
description: Berty is a peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted messaging app that works without internet using BLE and mDNS, designed for censorship-resistant and off-grid communications.

name: BigBlueButton
description: BigBlueButton is an open-source web conferencing system for online learning. It includes features for presentations, screen sharing, polling, and breakout rooms, widely used in education.

name: BillingOrchard
description: BillingOrchard is a billing and CRM platform designed for small to medium ISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Billmax
description: Billmax is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Billrun
description: Billrun is an open-source billing system designed specifically for telecom and ISPs. It offers features for rating, billing, and invoicing, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Bitchat
description: Bitchat is a decentralised peer-to-peer messaging app that works over Bluetooth mesh networks with no internet, servers, or phone numbers required.
notes: Available on iOS App Store; Bluetooth mesh only.

name: Bitwarden
description: Bitwarden is an open-source password manager with self-hosting support (Vaultwarden). It offers browser extensions, mobile apps, and CLI for secure credential management.

name: Bonfire
description: Bonfire is an open-source toolkit for federated digital spaces, enabling groups to manage, self-govern, and shape their own social infrastructures with tools for governance and community building.

name: BookStack
description: BookStack is an open-source, self-hosted knowledge management platform. It offers features for creating and managing documentation, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: Briar
description: Briar is a peer-to-peer encrypted messaging app that works over Bluetooth, WiFi, or Tor, enabling communication even without internet access. Designed for activists and at-risk communities.
notes: Used for offline messaging in community network contexts.

name: CHATONS
description: CHATONS (Collective of Alternative Transparent Open Neutral Solidarity Hosters) is a French collective bringing together structures offering free, ethical, decentralised online services as alternatives to GAFAM.
notes: Initiated by Framasoft in 2016; over 80 member organisations.

name: Cabal
description: Cabal is a peer-to-peer, local-first group chat platform using the Cabal protocol. It features subjective moderation, allowing each user to define their own trust graph.

name: Cacti
description: Cacti is a web-based network monitoring and graphing tool designed as a frontend application for the RRDtool. It allows users to poll services at predetermined intervals and graph the resulting data.
notes: Prometheus used now mainly?

name: CasaOS
description: CasaOS is a simple, easy-to-use, and open-source home cloud system built on top of Docker. It provides a user-friendly app store for self-hosted services.
notes: Notes test Editing works

name: Checkmk
description: Checkmk is an infrastructure monitoring platform available in a free open-source version (up to 25 nodes) and paid tiers. Used by community networks for network and server monitoring.
notes: Free for up to 25 nodes.

name: Chef
description: Chef is an open-source automation platform that transforms infrastructure into code. It is used for configuration management, application deployment, and infrastructure automation.

name: CinemaCMS / Cinemata
description: CinemataCMS is the open-source video platform powering Cinemata.org, a secure video platform for advocacy content in the Asia-Pacific region developed by EngageMedia.
notes: Used by EngageMedia in Asia-Pacific.

name: Cloudron
description: Cloudron is a platform for self-hosting web applications, providing one-click installation, automatic updates, backups, and SSL certificate management.

name: Codeberg
description: Codeberg is a free, non-profit, community-led code hosting platform based in Berlin, providing Git hosting and services for free and open-source software projects.

name: Colmena
description: Colmena is a productivity suite for local and community media enabling collaborative audio recording, conferences, and editing designed to work in areas of low connectivity.

name: Consul Democracy
description: Consul Democracy is an open-source citizen participation platform used by governments and organisations for transparent, democratic decision-making, including debates, proposals, and voting.

name: Coolify
description: Coolify is a self-hosted alternative to Heroku and Netlify, enabling easy deployment of applications, databases, and services on your own infrastructure with a modern UI.

name: CoreDNS
description: CoreDNS is a flexible and extensible DNS server that can serve as a drop-in replacement for other DNS servers. It is written in Go and supports plugins for extended functionality.

name: Cozy
description: Cozy is a personal cloud platform written in JavaScript enabling users to host their own data and applications, with an easy development environment for building personal apps.
notes: JS-based, easy to write own apps.

name: Crater
description: Crater is an open-source invoice and estimate management platform. It offers features for creating and managing invoices, tracking payments, and generating reports.

name: CrowdSec
description: CrowdSec is an open-source, collaborative security engine analysing behaviours and sharing threat intelligence across its community. Used to detect and block malicious traffic on community servers.

name: CryptPad
description: CryptPad is an end-to-end encrypted, zero-knowledge collaboration suite offering documents, spreadsheets, presentations, whiteboards, and kanban boards with no account required.

name: Cyberduck
description: Cyberduck is a libre server and cloud storage browser for Mac and Windows supporting FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Azure, OneDrive, Google Drive, and Dropbox.

name: DD-WRT
description: DD-WRT is a Linux-based firmware for wireless routers and access points. It provides advanced features such as VPN support, QoS, and wireless bridging.

name: DMA Radius Manager
description: DMA Radius Manager is an ISP billing and RADIUS management solution.

name: DataTill
description: DataTill is an ISP billing and accounting solution.

name: Decidim
description: Decidim is a free, open-source participatory democracy platform for cities, organisations, and communities. It supports proposals, voting, participatory budgeting, and deliberation.

name: Deflect
description: Deflect is a free infrastructure service for non-profits and civil society organisations to protect their websites from DDoS attacks and AI bot traffic.

name: Delta Chat
description: Delta Chat is a decentralised chat app that uses email infrastructure for message delivery. It supports webxdc mini-apps and works as a low-entry-point playground for exploring digital tools.
notes: Uses chatmail servers for low-latency delivery.

name: Diagrams.net (Draw.io)
description: Diagrams.net (formerly Draw.io) is an open-source diagramming tool with a wide range of templates and shapes. It can be used online or self-hosted and integrates with various platforms.

name: DietPi
description: DietPi is a highly optimised minimal Debian-based Linux distribution for single-board computers and servers. It uses less CPU, RAM, and storage than standard OS installations.

name: Dino
description: Dino is a modern, open-source XMPP/Jabber client for Linux desktops, supporting end-to-end encryption via OMEMO and a clean, modern interface.
notes: Used by Franciliens/YunoHost community.

name: Disroot
description: Disroot is a privacy-respecting, decentralised online services platform based in Amsterdam, offering email, cloud storage, forums, and other federated services maintained by volunteers.

name: Distributed Press
description: Distributed Press is an open-source publishing tool for the World Wide Web and DWeb, automating publishing and hosting content to the WWW while seeding to Hypercore and IPFS.

name: DokuWiki
description: DokuWiki is an open-source wiki software that doesn't require a database. It is simple to use, highly customizable, and suitable for creating and managing documentation.

name: Dolibarr
description: Dolibarr is an open-source ERP and CRM system designed for small and medium businesses. It offers modules for accounting, inventory, and project management, making it suitable for ISPs.

name: ERPNext
description: ERPNext is an open-source ERP system that includes modules for accounting, inventory, HR, and project management. It is highly customizable and suitable for ISPs and community networks.
types: ERP, Accounting, Inventory, HR, Project Management

name: Element / Matrix
description: Element is the primary client for the Matrix open federated messaging protocol. Matrix enables decentralised, end-to-end encrypted communications via a network of interconnected servers.
notes: matrix.org is the main homeserver. Also used by LibreMesh community.

name: EndlessOS
description: Endless OS is a Linux distribution optimised for first-time computer users and offline tool access, developed for solar learning labs and communities without reliable internet.

name: EpiCollect5
description: Epicollect5 is a free, easy-to-use mobile data-gathering platform for building and managing data collection forms, used by community organisations and research projects.
owner_project: Big Data Institute, University of Oxford
notes: Used by Janastu for community data collection.

name: Etherpad
description: Etherpad is an open-source, real-time collaborative text editor that allows multiple users to edit a document simultaneously, with a change history for each session.

name: Excalidraw
description: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn style diagrams, widely used as an open-source alternative to Jamboard, Miro, and FigJam.

name: FacilMap
description: FacilMap is a collaborative mapping tool based on OpenStreetMap, enabling groups to create shared maps with markers, lines, routes, and real-time collaboration.

name: FarmOS
description: FarmOS is an open-source web-based farm management, planning, and record-keeping system providing a collaborative platform for farmers to manage their operations.

name: FieldKit
description: FieldKit is open-source environmental monitoring hardware and software for scientists and communities to collect and share environmental data in the field.
notes: Hardware described as expensive.

name: Foreman
description: Foreman is an open-source lifecycle management tool for physical and virtual servers. It provides provisioning, configuration, and monitoring capabilities, making it useful for ISPs and community networks.

name: Frappe HR
description: Frappe HR is an open-source HRMS solution with over 13 different modules, including employee management, onboarding, leaves, payroll, and taxation. It is built on the Frappe Framework.

name: FreeRADIUS
description: FreeRADIUS is a multi-protocol policy server that implements RADIUS, DHCP, BFD, and ARP. It is widely used for authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) in network environments.
types: RADIUS Server, Authentication, Authentication, Network Management

name: FreeScout
description: FreeScout is a free, open-source PHP/MySQL helpdesk and shared mailbox application deployable on shared hosting. It supports unlimited agents, tickets, and mailboxes.

name: FreedomBox
description: FreedomBox is a Debian Pure Blend providing a personal server with free software for privacy and autonomy. Launched in 2010 by Prof. Eben Moglen to help users reclaim control of internet infrastructure.

name: Freeside
description: Freeside is an open-source WISP management platform.

name: FreshBooks
description: FreshBooks is a proprietary invoicing and accounting software designed for small businesses and freelancers. It offers features for invoicing, expense tracking, and time management.

name: Funkwhale
description: Funkwhale is a decentralised, federated audio streaming platform supporting music, podcasts, and radio. It uses the ActivityPub protocol to federate with the broader fediverse.

name: GLPI
description: GLPI is an open-source IT asset management and help desk software. It provides features for inventory management, ticketing, and reporting, making it useful for ISPs and community networks.

name: GNS3
description: GNS3 is a graphical network simulator that allows you to design and test complex network topologies. It supports a variety of virtual appliances and is widely used for network training and testing.

name: Gaiia
description: Gaiia is a network management platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for provisioning, network management, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Gajim
description: Gajim is a feature-rich XMPP/Jabber client for Linux and Windows with support for multi-user chat, file transfer, and OMEMO end-to-end encryption.
notes: Used by Franciliens/YunoHost community.

name: Galene
description: Galene is a self-hosted video conferencing server with low server resource requirements. It is used by NLnet Foundation for their community meetings.
notes: Used by NLnet Foundation.

name: Garage
description: Garage is an open-source distributed object storage service compatible with the S3 API, specifically designed and optimised for self-hosting in small clusters.

name: GetNOC
description: GetNOC is an open-source network management platform providing monitoring, inventory, and management features for network operations centres.

name: GetSimple CMS
description: GetSimple is a simple, flat-file CMS designed for small websites. It has no database dependency and focuses on ease of use with GPL open-source licensing. Over 120,000 downloads.

name: Goinbox
description: A scalable, affordable and modern ISP Billing Platform empowering Community Networks to start, grow and sustain internet access.

name: Grafana
description: Grafana is an open-source platform for monitoring and observability. It provides powerful visualization capabilities for metrics from various sources.
notes: Used by Altermundi for mesh network performance dashboards.
types: Monitoring, Analytics, Mesh Networking, Routing Protocol

name: Grav
description: Grav is a modern open-source flat-file CMS with no database required, focusing on simplicity and speed. Suitable for community network websites and documentation portals.

name: Grist
description: Grist is an open-source modern spreadsheet combining the flexibility of a spreadsheet with the power of a database. An alternative to Google Sheets with self-hosting support.

name: HSMN
description: HSMN is a hotspot management solution.

name: HedgeDoc
description: HedgeDoc (formerly CodiMD) is a self-hostable, collaborative Markdown editor allowing teams to write, share, and collaborate on documents in real-time using Markdown syntax.

name: Hetzner
description: Hetzner provides cloud hosting, virtual private servers (VPS), and dedicated servers with high performance and reliability. It is widely used by ISPs, developers, and businesses for hosting applications and infrastructure.

name: Hostbill
description: Hostbill is a billing and automation platform designed for ISPs and hosting providers. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it a comprehensive solution for ISP operations.

name: HumHub
description: HumHub is an open-source social networking platform and intranet solution. It provides a flexible platform for building private or community social networks with extensible modules.

name: IPFire
description: IPFire is a free network firewall distribution based on Linux. It includes an easy-to-use web management console and supports various add-ons for extended functionality.

name: ISP Bill
description: ISP Bill is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: ISPBox
description: ISPBox is a platform built by a WISP, for WISPs, designed to be fast, simple, and affordable. It includes customer and ticket management, service tracking, basic billing, and RADIUS integration right out of the box. Free for up to 20 subscribers!

name: ISPmate
description: ISPmate is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Icecast
description: Icecast is an open-source streaming media server supporting Ogg Vorbis, MP3, AAC, and WebM audio/video streams. Widely used for community radio and audio streaming over local networks.
notes: Used by community in Monteiro Lobato, Brazil on LibreMesh.

name: Icinga
description: Icinga is an open-source monitoring system that checks the availability of network resources, notifies users of outages, and generates performance data for reporting. It is a fork of Nagios and offers enhanced features and scalability.

name: Invoice Ninja
description: Invoice Ninja is an open-source invoicing and billing platform that offers features for creating and managing invoices, tracking payments, and generating reports. It is widely used by small businesses and ISPs.

name: IronWiFi
description: IronWiFi is an authentication solution for WiFi networks.

name: Jitsi Meet
description: Jitsi Meet is an open-source video conferencing platform that provides secure and scalable video meetings. It is widely used for remote collaboration and communication.

name: KeePassXC
description: KeePassXC is a modern, secure, offline password manager that stores credentials in an encrypted local database. Used with KeePassDX on mobile and synced via Nextcloud in community network orgs.
notes: Used by Nodo TAU, synced via Nextcloud.

name: Keycloak
description: Keycloak is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution. It provides SSO, identity brokering, and user federation, making it suitable for securing applications and services.
notes: Used by community networks for SSO across services.
types: SSO, Identity Provider, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Authentication

name: Kiwix
description: Kiwix is an offline web browser enabling access to Wikipedia, Khan Academy, and thousands of other websites without internet connectivity, using ZIM file format.
notes: Widely used across CCCI networks for offline content delivery.

name: Knapsack
description: Knapsack uses satellite file-casting technology to deliver digital content to locations otherwise disconnected due to remote geography, internet shutdowns, or high costs.

name: KoBoToolbox
description: KoBoToolbox is a free, open-source suite of tools for field data collection via mobile devices, used extensively in humanitarian, development, and research contexts.

name: Kolibri
description: Kolibri is an offline learning platform by Learning Equality, delivering educational content to communities without reliable internet access through local network distribution.
notes: Used by Assorcom in Myanmar for offline learning.

name: Lemmy
description: Lemmy is a federated link aggregator and Reddit clone for the fediverse. Communities can follow each other across instances using the ActivityPub protocol.

name: LibreMesh
description: LibreMesh is a modular framework for creating decentralized, community-owned mesh networks. It simplifies the deployment of mesh networks by providing pre-configured firmware for routers, enabling easy setup of self-organizing networks.

name: LibreNMS
description: LibreNMS is an auto-discovering PHP-based network monitoring system that supports a wide range of network hardware and operating systems. It provides real-time monitoring, alerting, and graphing of network devices.

name: LibreOffice
description: LibreOffice is a free and open-source office productivity suite including Writer (word processing), Calc (spreadsheets), Impress (presentations), and Draw (diagrams).
notes: Used by many CCCI community network members.

name: LibreQoS
description: LibreQoS reduces latency for interactive applications using Flow Queueing (FQ) and Active Queue Management (AQM) algorithms on a middlebox upstream of existing network equipment, requiring no router changes.

name: LibreSpeed
description: LibreSpeed is an open-source speed testing tool for self-hosted internet speed tests, allowing ISPs and community networks to provide branded local speed tests.
alternatives: Fast.com; Speedtest.net; iPerf, Ookla Speedtest; Fast.com
types: Speed Test, Network Testing, Communications, Messaging, P2P

name: LibreTime
description: LibreTime is an open-source radio automation and broadcasting solution helping community radio stations get on air with scheduling, live assistance, and stream management.
notes: Recommended by APC for community radio.

name: Libredesk
description: LibreDesk is a free and open-source helpdesk system designed for simplicity and self-hosting, providing ticket management and support workflows.

name: Limesurvey
description: LimeSurvey is a free, open-source online survey application supporting complex surveys, branching, multilingual surveys, and detailed statistics. Used by APC and many community organisations.

name: LiquidSoap
description: LiquidSoap is a powerful open-source audio and video streaming language used for creating dynamic radio streams, mixing audio sources, and scheduling broadcasts.

name: LiveKit
description: LiveKit is an open-source WebRTC infrastructure platform providing low-latency audio and video for applications. Being adopted by Matrix for conference calls.
notes: Matrix is adopting LiveKit for conferencing.

name: Loccarto
description: Loccarto is a radio-based tracking system that does not require GPS, developed by SLS for tracking assets in areas where GPS is unavailable or unreliable.
notes: Developed by SLS.

name: Lokole
description: Lokole is an offline email service for rural communities, students, and teachers. Using a 3G/4G modem, it batch-uploads and batch-downloads emails once per night at minimal cost.
notes: Developed by the Canadian-Congolese non-profit Ascoderu.

name: MBS
description: MBS is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Mailtrain
description: Mailtrain is a self-hosted newsletter application built on Nodemailer, providing an open-source alternative to Mailchimp for sending newsletters from your own server.
notes: Used by redecentralize.org.

name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is the most widely-used federated social network using the ActivityPub protocol. Self-hostable instances federate with the broader fediverse. Used as a Twitter/X alternative.
notes: Hometown is a notable fork keeping content local.

name: Matomo
description: Matomo is an open-source web analytics platform offering a privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics. User data stays on your own servers.
notes: Used by V-NET community network.

name: Matrix/Element
description: Matrix is an open-source project that publishes the Matrix open standard for decentralized communication. Element is a Matrix-based end-to-end encrypted messenger and collaboration app. It is suitable for secure team communication.

name: Mattermost
description: Mattermost is an open-source Slack alternative for team communication. It offers features for real-time messaging, file sharing, and integrations, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: MediaCMS
description: MediaCMS is an open-source, modern video and media platform for self-hosting, enabling communities to build a video service similar to YouTube on their own infrastructure.

name: Mermaid
description: Mermaid is an open-source JavaScript-based diagramming and charting tool. It uses a simple markup language to create diagrams and integrates with platforms like Grafana and documentation tools.

name: Meshtastic
description: Meshtastic is an open-source, off-grid, decentralized mesh network built on affordable LoRa radio hardware. It enables long-range text messaging without internet or cellular infrastructure.
notes: ~$30 hardware cost.

name: Mikorizal
description: Mikorizal Software develops tools for communities and networks working in new economic paradigms including REA (Resources, Events, Agents) accounting for solidarity economy networks.

name: MikroTik The Dude
description: The Dude is a free network monitoring tool by MikroTik that automatically scans devices within specified subnets, draws and layouts a map of your networks, monitors services, and alerts you in case of failures.

name: MikroTik User Manager
description: MikroTik User Manager is a built-in tool for managing hotspot users and billing on MikroTik routers. It provides features for user authentication, bandwidth management, and billing.

name: MintHCM
description: MintHCM is an open-source tool for Human Capital Management based on SugarCRM Community Edition and SuiteCRM. It provides features for managing employee data, recruitment, and performance.

name: Mobilizon
description: Mobilizon is a federated, ethical alternative to Facebook Events/Groups. It allows users to create events and group pages without tracking, likes, or infinite scrolling.

name: Mojaloop
description: Mojaloop is an open-source payment hub providing interoperable digital financial services, originally designed to enable affordable financial inclusion for unbanked populations.
notes: Used in GIZ financial inclusion projects.

name: Movim
description: Movim is an open-source social platform built on the XMPP protocol, offering a federated social network with blogging, chat, and group features.

name: NIS (Network Internet Services)
description: NIS is a billing and automation platform designed for ISPs. It offers features for billing, automation, and network management, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: NOC
description: NOC is a network management system for ISPs, service, and content providers.
types: Network Management, ISP, Service Provider, Content Provider

name: Nagios
description: Nagios is a powerful open-source monitoring system that enables organizations to identify and resolve IT infrastructure problems. It is widely used for monitoring network devices, servers, and services.

name: NetBox
description: NetBox is an open-source web application designed for managing and documenting computer networks. It provides IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) functionality.

name: Netskrt
description: Netskrt provides edge caching solutions for ISPs.

name: Nextcloud
description: Nextcloud is an open-source file sharing, collaboration, and communication platform. It offers features for file storage, team collaboration, and communication, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.
notes: Widely used across CCCI community networks.
types: Collaboration, File Sharing, Communication, File Storage, Collaboration, Productivity

name: NocoDB
description: NocoDB is an open-source Airtable alternative that turns any database into a smart spreadsheet with API access. Used as a Google Sheets alternative in CCCI contexts.

name: Node-RED
description: Node-RED is a flow-based development tool for visual programming, originally by IBM, for wiring together hardware devices, APIs, and online services as part of the Internet of Things.

name: Nostr
description: Nostr is a simple, open protocol enabling a truly censorship-resistant and global social network. Users control their own keys and can connect to any relay.
notes: Emerald is a notable Android client.

name: OBS Studio
description: OBS Studio is an open-source video recording and live-streaming application supporting multiple sources, scenes, and outputs. Used for recording BigBlueButton and Jitsi meetings.

name: OPNsense
description: OPNsense is an open-source FreeBSD-based firewall and router. It offers traffic shaping, load balancing, and VPN capabilities, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: Observium
description: Observium is a low-maintenance auto-discovering network monitoring platform supporting a wide range of device types, platforms, and operating systems. It offers both open-source and commercial versions.
notes: LibreNMS appears to be a fork of this.

name: Ollama
description: Ollama is an open-source tool for running large language models (LLMs) locally. It supports models like Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-R1, Phi-4, and Gemma 3, making it easy to deploy and manage AI models.

name: OneBill
description: OneBill is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Open WebUI
description: Open WebUI is a user-friendly AI interface that supports Ollama, OpenAI API, and other AI models. It provides a simple and intuitive way to interact with LLMs.

name: Open5GS
description: Open5GS is a C-language open source implementation of 3GPP's Evolved Packet Core (EPC/5GC), providing the core network for LTE and 5G community cellular networks.

name: OpenAudIT
description: OpenAudIT is an open-source tool for network discovery, inventory, and auditing. It helps ISPs and community networks keep track of their network assets and configurations.

name: OpenMPTCProuter
description: OpenMPTCProuter uses MultiPath TCP (MPTCP) to aggregate multiple internet connections (4G, ADSL, VDSL, fibre) and is built on OpenWrt, enabling bonded failover connectivity.

name: OpenMediaVault
description: OpenMediaVault is an open-source network attached storage (NAS) solution based on Debian Linux, providing a web-based management interface for home and community server storage.

name: OpenNMS
description: OpenNMS is an open-source network management platform that offers discovery, monitoring, and alerting for network devices. It is highly scalable and supports a wide range of protocols and devices.
notes: Mostly defunct?

name: OpenRefine
description: OpenRefine is a powerful open-source tool for working with messy data: cleaning it, transforming it from one format to another, and extending it with web services and external data.

name: OpenStreetMap (OSM)
description: OpenStreetMap is a collaborative project to create a free editable map of the world. It is widely used by community networks and ISPs for mapping network infrastructure and coverage areas.

name: OpenTelemetry
description: OpenTelemetry is a vendor-neutral open-source observability framework providing APIs, libraries, and agents for collecting distributed traces, metrics, and logs.

name: OpenVPN
description: OpenVPN is an open-source VPN solution that provides secure and private communication over the internet. It is widely used by ISPs and community networks to ensure secure connections.

name: OpenWISP
description: OpenWISP is a modular platform for managing Wi-Fi networks, including features for network topology visualization, device configuration, and monitoring. It is designed to be extensible and is widely used in community networks and wireless ISPs.

name: OpenWRT
description: OpenWRT is a highly extensible Linux-based operating system for embedded devices, primarily routers. It allows users to customize and manage network traffic, implement advanced routing protocols, and add packages for additional functionality.

name: OpenWrt
description: OpenWrt is a Linux-based router firmware featuring mesh networking, intrusion prevention via Snort, and Active Queue Management (AQM). It is highly customizable and widely used in community networks.

name: OpenWrt (mesh tutorial)
description: OpenWISP provides tutorials and resources for deploying OpenWrt-based mesh networks, including step-by-step guides for community network deployments.

name: Openwisp
description: OpenWISP is an open-source, modular, hackable network management system used for managing OpenWrt device fleets including configuration, monitoring, and network topology. Used by Internet Para Todos in Mexico.
notes: Biggest deployment: Internet Para Todos, Mexico (thousands of devices).

name: Outline
description: Outline is a self-hostable knowledge base and wiki platform for teams, with a clean interface, Markdown support, and real-time collaboration features. An open-source Notion alternative.

name: Owncast
description: Owncast is a self-hosted, open-source, decentralised livestreaming platform that integrates with existing broadcast tools (OBS). Provides a tracking-free alternative to Twitch and YouTube Live.

name: Oxide
description: Oxide is an open-source network device management platform designed for managing and provisioning network devices. It is suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: Oxidized
description: Oxidized is an open-source network device configuration backup tool. It automatically backs up configurations from network devices and tracks changes over time.

name: PRTG Network Monitor
description: PRTG Network Monitor is a proprietary network monitoring tool that provides real-time monitoring, alerting, and reporting for network devices. It offers a free tier for small networks.

name: PSLab
description: PSLab (Pocket Science Lab) is an open-source scientific hardware and software platform enabling communities to measure and collect environmental and scientific data with a cost of ~89 EUR.

name: PacketFence
description: PacketFence is a fully supported free and open source Network Access Control (NAC) solution with captive portal, wired/wireless/VPN management, BYOD, 802.1X, and layer-2 isolation capabilities.

name: Pagekite
description: Pagekite is a fast, open-source, reliable localhost tunnelling solution that makes local servers accessible from anywhere via a public URL.

name: PeerTube
description: PeerTube is a decentralised, federated video hosting platform using ActivityPub and WebTorrent for peer-to-peer video delivery. An ethical alternative to YouTube.

name: Pi-hole
description: Pi-hole is an open-source DNS sinkhole that protects your devices from unwanted content without installing client-side software. It also provides network-level ad blocking.

name: Pixelfed
description: Pixelfed is a federated, open-source photo sharing platform compatible with the ActivityPub protocol, offering an ethical alternative to Instagram.

name: Pleroma
description: Pleroma is a lightweight, ActivityPub-compatible federated social networking server. It has a significantly smaller resource footprint than Mastodon, making it suitable for low-resource community servers.
notes: Preferred by many community network admins for its lighter resource use.

name: PowerDNS
description: PowerDNS is an open-source DNS server that supports a variety of backends, including databases and load balancing. It is highly scalable and widely used for managing DNS infrastructure.

name: Powercode
description: Powercode is a billing and automation platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for CRM, billing, and network management, making it a comprehensive solution for ISP operations.

name: PreTalx
description: PreTalx is an open-source conference management tool supporting call-for-papers, scheduling, and speaker management. Used by FOSS4G and other open-source conferences.
notes: Used by FOSS4G.

name: Preseem
description: Preseem is a network management and monitoring platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for real-time network monitoring, bandwidth management, and customer support.

name: Prometheus
description: Prometheus is a powerful time-series database and monitoring system with a flexible data model designed for high-frequency metrics. Often used as the data source for Grafana.
alternatives: Zabbix; Nagios; Icinga; Checkmk, InfluxDB; Zabbix
notes: Used by BigBlueButton monitoring setups.
types: Bonding, Network Management, Firmware, Monitoring, Analytics, Network Management

name: Proxmox VE
description: Proxmox Virtual Environment is an open-source server virtualisation management platform supporting KVM and LXC containers, commonly used in community network server infrastructure.
notes: Used for hypervisor and server monitoring in community networks.

name: QGIS
description: QGIS is an open-source Geographic Information System (GIS) that allows users to create, edit, visualize, analyze, and publish geospatial information. It is useful for planning and visualizing network infrastructure.
notes: Used by Colnodo at etnoterritorios.org.

name: Quiet
description: Quiet syncs messages directly between team devices over Tor, with no server required. Unlike Slack, Discord, or Signal, it uses no central servers at all.

name: RANCID
description: RANCID is an open-source tool for network device configuration management. It monitors network devices for changes and maintains a history of configurations, making it useful for ISPs and community networks.
types: Network Configuration Management, Monitoring, Provisioning, Configuration Management

name: RackNap
description: RackNap is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: RackTables
description: RackTables is an open-source tool for managing datacenter and server room assets. It allows you to document hardware assets, network addresses, rack space, and network configurations.

name: Radicle
description: Radicle is a peer-to-peer code collaboration network built on Git, enabling decentralised software development without reliance on centralised hosting platforms like GitHub.

name: Radiusdesk
description: Radiusdesk is an open-source mesh and AP dashboard that provides a frontend to FreeRADIUS, enabling hotspot and captive portal management for community networks and WISPs.

name: Ready BOSS
description: Ready BOSS is an ISP subscriber experience platform built from scratch to help you deliver seamless, secure subscriber experiences. Ready integrates with other systems in your stack to power subscriber interactions throughout the customer lifecycle, from finding, engaging, and signing up prospects in your territory, to self-service onboarding and your subscriber portal, all white-labeled to your brand. Ready BOSS is hardware-neutral, so you can use it for all subscribers on your network, regardless of which equipment you used to connect them.

name: Reticulum
description: Reticulum is a cryptography-based networking stack designed for reliable communication over high-latency, low-bandwidth radio links and other unreliable media, requiring no central infrastructure.
notes: Version 1.0.0 released recently.

name: RetroShare
description: RetroShare is a Friend-to-Friend secure communication and file sharing platform working on local networks and the internet. It is delay-tolerant and supports communities with intermittent connectivity.
notes: Considered the safest option due to no user-discovery mechanisms.

name: Revolt
description: Revolt is a free, open-source, GDPR-compliant chat platform designed as a privacy-first alternative to Discord, supporting text channels, bots, and fine-grained permissions without ads or trackers.
notes: Launched 2021; GDPR compliant.

name: Rocket.Chat
description: Rocket.Chat is an open-source team chat platform. It offers features for real-time messaging, file sharing, and integrations, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: RtBRICK
description: RtBRICK is an open-source network test tool for BNG.

name: Runtipi
description: Runtipi is a homeserver manager providing one-click installation of self-hosted applications via a Docker-based app store with a simple, clean web interface.

name: SaltStack
description: SaltStack is an open-source automation and configuration management tool. It is designed for data center automation, cloud control, and IT orchestration.

name: Scuttlebutt (SSB)
description: Secure Scuttlebutt is a peer-to-peer social network that works offline. It does not require internet access and is censorship-resistant, making it suitable for communities with intermittent connectivity.
notes: Works offline via gossip replication; used by many dweb communities.

name: Session
description: Session is a decentralised, end-to-end encrypted messenger requiring no phone number or email to register. Messages are routed through a decentralised network of service nodes, with no metadata collection.
notes: Forked from Signal; routes via Tor-like swarm.

name: Sideband
description: Sideband is an LXMF client for Android, Linux and macOS enabling communication over Reticulum networks using LoRa, Packet Radio, WiFi, I2P, and other supported media.

name: Signal
description: Signal is an end-to-end encrypted messaging app for private communications including text, voice, and video calls. Widely regarded as the gold standard for secure messaging.

name: SimpleX Chat
description: SimpleX Chat has no user identifiers of any kind — no phone numbers, usernames, or keys linked to identity. Decentralised, with anyone able to run their own servers, and immune to spam.

name: Smokeping
description: Smokeping is an open-source tool for monitoring network latency. It visualizes latency measurements over time, helping ISPs and community networks identify and troubleshoot latency issues.

name: Snikkit
description: Snikket is an easy-to-deploy XMPP messaging platform focused on private group communication, aiming to make self-hosted messaging accessible for communities and families.

name: Snipe-IT
description: Snipe-IT is an open-source asset and license management software. It provides a user-friendly interface for tracking hardware and software assets, making it ideal for ISPs and IT departments.

name: SolarSPELL
description: SolarSPELL is an ultra-portable, ruggedized, education-focused digital library generating its own WiFi hotspot for offline content access in low-resource contexts. Paired with local trainers.

name: Sonar
description: Sonar is an all-in-one ISP management platform that includes CRM, billing, support, and network management features. It is designed specifically for ISPs and WISPs and is highly scalable and extensible via an API. Hosting is included in the cost of the service.

name: SonoBus
description: SonoBus is an application for streaming high-quality, low-latency peer-to-peer audio between devices over the internet or a local network, useful for remote music collaboration.

name: Splynx
description: Splynx is a cost-effective WISP billing and network management system. Its features enable WISPs to automate billing, invoicing, and payments, centrally control network infrastructure, manage customers, and provide carrier-grade support. Splynx provides an easy way to create additional modules or integrate it with third-party software solutions due to its powerful API.

name: Swift Fox
description: Swift Fox is a WISP management software suite that includes real-time network monitoring, automated billing, customer bandwidth tracking and provisioning, and call center management. Also included are WISP-specific tools such as radio path profiles and frequency coordination features.

name: Sympa
description: Sympa is an open-source electronic mailing list manager. It is used by RiseUp and other privacy-respecting hosting providers for community and activist mailing lists.
notes: Used by RiseUp.net.

name: Syncthing
description: Syncthing is a continuous peer-to-peer file synchronisation tool that works without any central server or cloud storage. Files are synced directly between devices over local networks or the internet.
notes: Not available on iOS.

name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale is a zero-config VPN built on WireGuard that creates secure peer-to-peer connections between devices. It simplifies remote network access without requiring complex firewall configurations.

name: Technitium DNS Server
description: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source, self-hosted DNS server that supports both authoritative and recursive DNS services. It includes a user-friendly web interface for management.

name: Tella
description: Tella makes it easier and safer to document human rights violations and collect data in challenging environments with limited connectivity or in the face of repression.

name: Terrastories
description: Terrastories is an open-source geostorytelling application enabling indigenous and local communities to map and record oral histories and place-based stories on an offline-capable map.
notes: Part of the Earth Defenders Toolkit.

name: Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware
description: Tiki Wiki is a full-featured, open-source wiki and content management system. It offers a wide range of features for collaboration, documentation, and knowledge management.

name: TollGate
description: TollGate enables WiFi routers to accept Bitcoin Lightning Network payments for internet access, allowing routers and internet connections to operate as micro-ISPs.

name: Tox
description: Tox is an instant messaging application designed for secure, decentralised communication without central servers.

name: Twenty
description: Twenty is an open-source CRM similar to Salesforce.

name: UCRM
description: UCRM is a free software platform provided by Ubiquiti. It provides billing features like recurring invoicing and automated shut-off for late payments.

name: Umbrel
description: Umbrel is a personal server operating system providing a curated app store for self-hosted services, designed to be accessible to non-technical users.

name: UnPoller
description: UnPoller collects data from UniFi Controllers, Sites, Devices, and Clients.

name: Unimus
description: Unimus is a network automation and configuration management tool that provides automated backups, mass configuration changes, and compliance reporting for network devices.
types: Network Automation, Configuration Backup, Network Management

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted website monitoring tool similar to 'Uptime Robot.' It provides real-time monitoring of websites and services, with notifications for downtime.

name: VISP
description: VISP is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Vaultwarden
description: Vaultwarden is a lightweight, open-source Bitwarden server API implementation written in Rust. It allows you to self-host your own password manager.

name: VideoCacheBox
description: VideoCacheBox is a caching solution for video content.

name: Visp.net
description: Visp.net is a cloud-based ISP management software that offers billing, CRM, and support features. It is designed for ISPs and WISPs and provides a user-friendly interface.

name: Vocdoni
description: Vocdoni is a decentralised digital voting and collective decision-making platform. Developed with links to GuifiNet/exco, it provides a secure, censorship-resistant voting protocol.

name: VyOS
description: VyOS is an open-source network operating system (router OS) based on Linux, supporting advanced routing, firewalling, VPN, and traffic shaping for network appliances.

name: WHMCS
description: WHMCS is a popular billing and automation platform designed for hosting providers and ISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it a comprehensive solution for ISP operations.

name: WISPgate
description: WISPgate is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: Webrecorder
description: Webrecorder is an open-source toolkit for creating high-fidelity, interactive archives of websites, enabling communities to preserve web content for documentation and advocacy.

name: WeeWX
description: WeeWX is a free, open-source weather station monitoring program written in Python. It generates web pages, archive files, and reports from weather station data.

name: Wiki.js
description: Wiki.js is an open-source, modern wiki platform. It offers features for creating and managing documentation, making it suitable for ISPs and community networks.

name: WireGuard
description: WireGuard is a modern, open-source VPN that uses state-of-the-art cryptography. It is designed to be faster, simpler, and more secure than traditional VPNs.

name: XceedNet
description: XceedNet is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: YeswWiki
description: YesWiki is an open-source, easy-to-use wiki platform for community collaboration and collective intelligence, with features for forms, maps, and collaborative content.

name: Yggdrasil
description: Yggdrasil is an early-stage implementation of a fully end-to-end encrypted IPv6 network, using a globally consistent distributed routing scheme that works across any network topology.

name: YunoHost
description: YunoHost is a server operating system aimed at making self-hosting accessible to everyone. It simplifies installation and management of web applications on a personal server.
notes: Used extensively by community network groups.

name: Zabbix
description: Zabbix is an enterprise-grade open-source monitoring solution for networks, servers, and applications. It offers real-time monitoring, alerting, and visualization of network performance metrics.

name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk is a proprietary customer support platform that provides ticketing, live chat, and help center features. It is widely used by businesses of all sizes, including ISPs.

name: ZeroTier
description: ZeroTier creates software-defined virtual networks, enabling devices across the internet to communicate as if on the same local network. Widely used by community networks for remote router access.
notes: Used by Nupef/Quilombola community for remote router access.

name: Zotero
description: Zotero is a free, open-source reference management tool that helps users collect, organise, cite, and share research. An alternative to Mendeley and EndNote.

name: Zulip
description: Zulip is an open-source team chat application with a unique threading model. It is used by Altermundi and others in the community network space as a collaboration tool.
notes: Used by Altermundi community network.

name: Zuper
description: Zuper is a billing and CRM platform designed for ISPs and WISPs. It offers features for billing, CRM, and automation, making it suitable for ISP operations.

name: cnMaestro
description: cnMaestro is a software platform provided by Cambium Networks for managing and monitoring wireless networks. It offers features for device management, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting.

name: disaster.radio
description: disaster.radio is a disaster-resilient communications network using low-power solar-powered mesh nodes based on LoRa transceivers and ESP32 microcontrollers, providing off-grid connectivity.
notes: Hardware uses ESP32 + LoRa SX1276.

name: dnsmasq
description: dnsmasq is a lightweight, open-source tool that provides DNS caching, a DHCP server, and TFTP support. It is commonly used in small networks and embedded systems.

name: iNethi
description: iNethi is an open-source community network management ecosystem developed in South Africa, supporting local payment systems, network monitoring, and community service deployment.
notes: 3-country deployment underway; SmartSDN project.

name: iTop
description: iTop is an open-source IT service management tool that includes a Configuration Management Database (CMDB). It is designed for managing IT infrastructure and services.

name: ndm (Network DNS Manager)
description: ndm greatly simplifies configuring and managing DNS and DHCP services for small home or business networks, runnable on a Raspberry Pi or any small Linux system.

name: osTicket
description: osTicket is an open-source ticketing system that provides a simple and intuitive interface for managing customer support requests. It is widely used by ISPs and community networks for its ease of use and flexibility.

name: p2panda
description: p2panda provides building blocks for peer-to-peer networks, offering reusable components for building decentralized applications with a focus on community use.

name: pfSense CE
description: pfSense Community Edition is a free network firewall distribution based on FreeBSD. It includes third-party free software packages for additional functionality, such as VPN and traffic shaping.

name: phpIPAM
description: phpIPAM is an open-source IP address management tool with PowerDNS integration. It provides a web-based interface for managing IP addresses, subnets, and DNS records.

name: rConfig
description: rConfig is an open-source network device configuration management tool. It provides features for backing up, managing, and monitoring network device configurations.

name: sig0namectl
description: sig0namectl promotes secure DNS usage and enables real-time decentralised DNS updates by both machines and people, developed by Adam Burns (former Pegasus Networks Technical Director).
